video_title: Steve Kerr, Brandon Williams discuss Warriors return outlook | NBC Sports BA

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Brandon Williams' practice status and availability
quotes.excerpt: He's questionable for tomorrow, but I'm hopeful that he'll play.
quotes.quote: He practiced. We did some light scrimmage stuff where we're executing stuff against our coaches. It's live, but it's not quite player on player. He made it through everything, and he's questionable for tomorrow, but I'm hopeful that he'll play.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says Brandon Williams practiced today and is questionable for tomorrow's game. Kerr is hopeful he will play.

structured.context: Steve Kerr provides an update on Brandon Williams practicing and his questionable status for the upcoming game.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on Brandon Williams' speed and impact on defense
quotes.excerpt: His speed is a real weapon for us, and it'll be great to have him back.
quotes.quote: He's so fast. On the road trip, we dealt with a lot of ball pressure, and that's where we really missed him, his ability to say, 'Okay, you want to pressure like that? I'm going to take the ball right past you and create something.' His speed is a real weapon for us, and it'll be great to have him back.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on the return of Brandon Williams: His speed is a real weapon for us and it will be great to have him back.

structured.context: Steve Kerr explains how Brandon Williams' speed helps the team handle defensive ball pressure.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the emotional impact of Stephen Curry's presence
quotes.excerpt: There's just a different vibe when Steph is in the building.
quotes.quote: He's always a breath of fresh air. The humor and the confidence that he has. You saw the other night, Draymond hits a three from the corner and he's flying all over the place on the bench. There's just a different vibe when Steph is in the building, and it's good to have him here even if he's not playing.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on Stephen Curry's presence on the bench: There is just a different vibe when Steph is in the building even if he is not playing.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses the positive energy Stephen Curry brings to the team even while he is not playing.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the value of veteran leadership on the team
quotes.excerpt: I love the internal leadership we have on this team. Our vets have been fantastic.
quotes.quote: I love the internal leadership we have on this team. Our vets have been fantastic. Draymond's leadership every day has been brilliant. Al and Steph are more the quiet leaders by example, but pull a guy aside and talk to him. Our veteran players have provided such great leadership for us this year, and it's really helpful, especially for the young guys and Brandon in particular, given how much he's playing.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr praises the leadership of Draymond Green, Al Horford, and Steph Curry: Our veteran players have provided such great leadership for us this year.

structured.context: Steve Kerr praises the veteran leadership provided by Draymond Green, Stephen Curry, and Al Horford for the younger players.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on managing the learning curve for young players
quotes.excerpt: You can't learn it all in 15 games. There's a big learning curve.
quotes.quote: We're trying to simplify the message. Understand that there's a lot to learn, and you can't learn it all in 15 games. He's going to make mistakes, so it's fine. Just try to learn and go, and understand that it's going to take time for anybody. Even the best players in the world, you look at Wembanyama's first year, he had some great games, but he was nowhere near what he is now. Same with LeBron or Steph Curry's rookie year compared to now. There's a big learning curve, but it's really about letting him play and teaching him without hammering home too many things.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on the rookie learning curve: You look at Wembanyama's first year, he had some great games, but he was nowhere near what he is now. It is going to take time.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses the learning curve for young players like Brandon Williams by comparing them to established stars.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on his decision to leave Twitter years ago
quotes.excerpt: James Wiseman and I went off of Twitter together, and I realized almost right away how blissful it was.
quotes.quote: Six or seven years ago, James Wiseman and I went off of Twitter together, and I realized almost right away how blissful it was. I have not been back, and so a lot of this stuff happens and I'm unaware of it, which is probably a good thing for my mental health given the position I'm in and all the critiquing that comes our way.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on why he left Twitter years ago: I realized almost right away how blissful it was. I have not been back and it is probably a good thing for my mental health.

structured.context: Steve Kerr reflects on his decision to leave Twitter years ago and how it benefits his mental health.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the difficulty of being an athlete today
quotes.excerpt: It's never been more difficult to be an athlete than it is today.
quotes.quote: It's never been more difficult to be an athlete than it is today because of social media, because of the eyes that are on every single one of their moves on and off the court. It's very, very difficult what these guys face every day.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr says it has never been more difficult to be an athlete than it is today because of social media and the constant eyes on every single move.

structured.context: Steve Kerr comments on the increased difficulty of being a professional athlete today due to social media scrutiny.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the realities of the NBA job
quotes.excerpt: When you get into the NBA, you should expect boos, injuries, trades, contract disputes.
quotes.quote: One of the things I've talked to him about is the realities of this job. When you get into the NBA, you should expect boos, injuries, trades, contract disputes. This is what the job entails, and it's probably at some point in your career coming for everybody. Some guys do it like Draymond and just attack it head-on and take on all comers. Some people do it like I do and ignore it. Everyone has to figure out for themselves.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on how he coaches players to handle NBA pressure: Some guys attack it head-on like Draymond, some people do it like I do and ignore it. Everyone has to figure it out.

structured.context: Steve Kerr discusses the realities of an NBA career including dealing with boos, injuries, and trades.

quotes.speaker: Steve Kerr
quotes.summary_phrase: Steve Kerr on the need for Brandon Williams' skill set
quotes.excerpt: Every team needs somebody like that, and he's one of our best players already.
quotes.quote: There's a glaring need for Brandon on this team as a big wing who can dribble, pass, and shoot, and process the game. Every team needs somebody like that, and he's one of our best players already. It doesn't happen often where you get a rookie who immediately becomes one of your best players, but Brandon is that talented.
quotes.social_post: Steve Kerr on Brandon Williams: It does not happen often where you get a rookie who immediately becomes one of your best players, but Brandon is that talented.

structured.context: Steve Kerr highlights the importance of Brandon Williams' skill set to the team's success.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on his health and readiness for tomorrow
quotes.excerpt: I feel good. I got the best trainers, everybody here, so hopefully I'll be good for tomorrow.
quotes.quote: I feel good. I got the best trainers, everybody here, so hopefully I'll be good for tomorrow.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on his injury status: I feel good. I got the best trainers, everybody here, so hopefully I will be good for tomorrow.

structured.context: Brandon Williams expresses optimism about his health and readiness for the next game.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on the injury that sidelined him
quotes.excerpt: I felt it that second time with Jordan Poole and caught a timeout.
quotes.quote: Well, it happened on the first play when I went against Queen the first time. Then we went back on defense, we were in our set defense and I was just testing it out a little bit. I wanted to confirm, I wanted to do a move that I do all the time, the low pick-up, and I felt it that second time with Jordan Poole and caught a timeout. During the timeout, I was stretching it out a little bit, then I came back here and ultimately it just led to me being out, but just being precaution more than anything.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams explains the moment he felt his hamstring injury: I wanted to do a move that I do all the time, the low pick-up, and I felt it.

structured.context: Brandon Williams describes the moment he felt his injury during a game against Jordan Poole.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on his role in stabilizing the offense
quotes.excerpt: The offense gets stagnant at times and I know that's what they brought me in here for.
quotes.quote: I know exactly what I need to do. Just watching from afar, not being in the game, you see a little bit more. The offense gets stagnant at times and I know that's what they brought me in here for, to keep it rolling, keep it going, keep everybody organized and stuff. Hopefully we see that the next time I get on the court for sure.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on his role for the Warriors: The offense gets stagnant at times and I know that is what they brought me in here for, to keep it rolling.

structured.context: Brandon Williams explains his role in organizing the offense when it becomes stagnant.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on team morale and the next-man-up mentality
quotes.excerpt: It's the next man up. I think the thing out here is strength in numbers.
quotes.quote: It helps a lot. Specifically for me, those teams that I've been on, like Kyrie went down and the morale around the team just went down. It's complete opposite case here. Everybody's the next man up. I think the thing out here is strength in numbers. I think that's a great motto to live by and it's perfect for us right now. Everybody got to step up, whether it's Draymond, Steph, Al, Graham, all of us got to step up, so it's a collective group effort.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on the Warriors culture: Strength in numbers is a great motto to live by and it is perfect for us right now.

structured.context: Brandon Williams discusses the team's next-man-up mentality and collective effort.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on balancing workload and injury recovery
quotes.excerpt: It's a balance of being smart with your workload, but at the same time I want to test.
quotes.quote: It's a balance of being smart with your workload, but at the same time I want to test other things. I want to test. After it happened the first couple days I didn't really do too much, so I'm just itching to play basketball and everybody here knows I love basketball. If I get on the court and I probably maybe doing a little too much and they'll drag me off of it, but it's just that competitive spirit like I said that all of us have. And then with the hamstring, it's a thing that us explosive athletes always go through, and like I said we just have to be smart with the trainers, doctors, and everybody here.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on his recovery: I am just itching to play basketball and everybody here knows I love basketball. We just have to be smart with the trainers.

structured.context: Brandon Williams talks about the balance between his competitive desire to play and managing his hamstring injury.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on playing with Anthony Melton
quotes.excerpt: It's a gift and a curse. I'm almost at his house almost too much.
quotes.quote: It's great. It's a gift and a curse. I'm almost at his house almost too much. Like yesterday I borrowed his washer and dryer the whole day, watched the Bengals game and stuff, was just chilling. But it's good to have someone on the team who's been here for a year, two, or three. He knows the system a little bit, knows everybody in the building, so it's great to have that familiarity for sure.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on his friendship with Anthony Melton: I am almost at his house almost too much. Yesterday I borrowed his washer and dryer the whole day.

structured.context: Brandon Williams discusses his close friendship and living proximity to teammate De'Anthony Melton.

quotes.speaker: Brandon Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Brandon Williams on Anthony Melton's evolution as a player
quotes.excerpt: He is a whole different player, bro. He don't play exactly how he played now.
quotes.quote: Honestly, he is a whole different player, bro. He don't play exactly how he played now. Back then he was a guy who was playing one through five offensively and defensively. Couldn't really shoot as much back then. He was just a dog back then. Not to say he's not now, but he kind of did a little bit of everything. Now he's a catch-and-shoot 3-and-D, handles the ball, and I'd be getting on him about that too. But no, it's been smooth. It's been good. I look at him as a cousin, we grew up together, so it's perfect.
quotes.social_post: Brandon Williams on Anthony Melton's evolution: Honestly, he is a whole different player. Back then he was a guy playing one through five, now he is a catch-and-shoot 3-and-D guy.

structured.context: Brandon Williams describes how De'Anthony Melton has evolved as a player since they grew up together.
